description: Search for products across configured Swiss grocery chains (Migros, Coop, Aldi, Denner, Lidl, Farmy, Volgshop, Otto's, Coop City) by keyword. The `coop` chain covers the coop.ch supermarket assortment (groceries, household, drugstore) only. The Coop City department-store range (coop-city.ch: cosmetics, fashion, household, electronics) is the separate `coopcity` chain, which is opt-in: include it in `chains` to search it (it is skipped when `chains` is omitted). Supports optional filters for price, size range, and product tags (organic, vegan, budget, etc.). Returns results grouped by chain with normalised price, unit price, size, and promotion info. A `sources` map reports each chain's data freshness (fetchedAt timestamp + fromCache flag) so you can tell the user how current the prices are. Every queried chain has a key in `byChain`; when a chain fails (e.g. bot protection or an outage) its array is empty and `errors` lists the chain with a code and reason, so check `errors` before telling the user a chain has no results. Use for "find organic milk under 2 CHF", "compare pasta prices", or "search for gluten-free bread".

inputSchema.description: Search for products across configured Swiss grocery chains by keyword, with optional price, size, and tag filters. Returns results grouped by chain.

chains.description: Restrict search to specific chains. Omit to search all configured chains in parallel. Coop City (coopcity) is opt-in and only included when listed here.

filters.description: Optional product filters applied after search.

maxPrice.description: Maximum product price in CHF (inclusive), e.g. 3.5.

sizeRange.description: Size range filter in millilitres; useful for beverages and liquids.

tags.description: Product tags to filter by, e.g. ["organic", "vegan"]. All tags must match.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per chain (1–50). Defaults to chain-specific limit.

offset.description: Skip the first N results per chain. Use with `limit` to paginate. Default 0.

query.description: Search term in any language, e.g. "Milch", "pâtes", "Bier". At least 1 character.

storeIds.description: Filter results to products available in these store IDs (chain-specific internal IDs).

name: search_products
